captions.detailed: A three-branch inspection fixture head consisting of a vertical rectangular black spine supporting three dark blue arms. The lower arm rotates about a transverse axis on a U-shaped trunnion housing, ending in a grey rectangular mounting pad with a black slot. The middle arm extends horizontally from a vertical pivot collar and ends in a grey circular mounting pad with three holes. The upper arm extends forward from a cylindrical collar, rotating about its longitudinal axis, and ends in a grey rectangular mounting pad with two vertical black slots.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated three-branch inspection fixture head with a central vertical spine. The fixture should feature a lower arm rotating on a transverse axis, a middle arm pivoting on a vertical axis, and an upper arm rotating on a longitudinal axis, each terminating in distinct grey mounting pads.
captions.factory: Construct a main vertical rectangular spine with flat end caps. Create three separate joint housings on the spine: a lower U-shaped bracket, a middle horizontal collar, and an upper cylindrical collar. Model three square-profile dark blue arms, each attached to its respective housing. Attach distinct end pads to each arm: a circular disk with three hole indentations for the middle arm, a rectangular block with a single horizontal slot for the lower arm, and a rectangular block with two vertical slots for the upper arm.
